verdict: Chief design and all toy numeric expectations pass this review; no material mathematical defect found.

corrections.finding: The required drawdown value and severe scenario are well-defined, but repeated peaks/troughs and zero loss do not determine unique reported locations.
corrections.evidence: Toy [100,120,120,90,90] has four maximizing pairs and 25% loss. [100,110,120] has zero loss and three coincident peak/trough choices.
corrections.proposed_correction: Before accepting the future driver, specify: scan initial (year 0), then each year's post_fee and end observations; update peak only on a strict increase and selected drawdown only on a strict increase; initialize both selected locations to (0,initial). This selects earliest peak/trough, including the zero-loss case. The scenario tie-break remains exact loss then smallest scenario ID.
corrections.reason_not_blocking: Every maximizing pair reports the same numeric loss. The plan explicitly requires a separate driver review before dispatch; fix this reporting convention there.

corrections.finding: Net annual real returns are derivable but not explicitly named as ledger columns; paired CSV split and baseline identity are implicit in the manifest/prose.
corrections.proposed_correction: Make the future CSV schema explicit: annual_net_real_return=real_end_t/real_end_(t-1)-1 with real_end_0=100; name this a decimal return, optionally add annual_net_real_return_pct=100*annual_net_real_return. Include split, alternative_policy, reference_policy=equal_weight_annual and horizon in paired_differences.csv, plus units for each difference. Add profile-to-horizon mapping to the run manifest. These columns make detached evidence self-describing.
corrections.reason_not_blocking: All quantities and identities are already recoverable exactly from specified holdings, CPI, keys and manifest. No new mathematical parameter is needed.

corrections.location: specs/ACCOUNTING.md: trade share excluding initial / H=1
corrections.finding: H=1 fluctuation is explicitly undefined in the oracle; H=1 trade share excluding initial would also have a zero denominator.
corrections.proposed_correction: For any later H=1 consumer, return null for volatility and trade_share_excluding_initial_pct, retain later_trade_count=0 and later_review_count=0, and reject attempts to coerce either undefined statistic to zero. The present pilot remains restricted to H in {5,6,15,25,30} and finite defined metrics.
corrections.reason_not_blocking: The present plan explicitly excludes H=1 metrics; all actual denominators are positive.

limitations: Pinned design and toy arithmetic only; not a production implementation review.
No scenario CSV, raw data, final data, performance or later production code read.
Input hash declaration checked against pinned configuration/task only; actual dataset hash remains HY3's separate responsibility.
Toy prefix, separation and timing checks validate this independent mathematical interpretation only.
